page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.2xlarge is a compute-oriented virtual server instance belonging to the Enhanced family, hosted on the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile features an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is provisioned with 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 4 physical cores using simultaneous multithreading, along with 16.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware cache provisions include 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of shared L3 cache, complemented by vector and cryptographic instruction support including AVX-512 VNNI, VAES, and SHA-NI.

The compute subsystem delivers consistent mid-tier throughput across diverse synthetic workloads, demonstrated by a Geekbench multi-core score of 5909.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 11379.24. Memory subsystem performance reports uncached large-block read bandwidth of 60.18 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 42.4 GB/sec. Data processing tests show bzip3 multi-threaded decompression speeds reaching 42.19 GB/sec alongside gzip single-threaded compression throughput of 28.07 GB/sec. Static web serving throughput reaches 11.83 GB/sec, while in-memory Redis SET operations sustain 8.0 million operations per second.

Hardware tradeoffs are evident in storage and accelerator provisions. The ecs.c7se.2xlarge contains no local storage and zero dedicated GPUs, requiring external network-attached volumes for persistent data and restricting hardware-accelerated computation. Baseline network throughput is rated at 3 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Synthetic machine learning benchmarks reflect these architectural boundaries: while small 135M parameter models process prompts at 764.59 tokens per second, 7B parameter models drop to 15.94 tokens per second during prompt ingestion and 7.9 tokens per second for generation, with 70B models completely unsupported due to memory constraints.

In terms of resource density, the instance offers balanced compute efficiency for CPU-bound tasks that do not demand expansive memory footprints. The ecs.c7se.2xlarge fits standard web serving, Clang compilation pipelines, continuous integration nodes, intermediate batch data processing, and microservice backends that pair with external block storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.2xlarge is an x86_64 compute-oriented instance powered by a dedicated 2.9 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor. It provides 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores and 16.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation. The architecture includes 48 MB of L3 cache with AVX-512 and cryptographic instruction extensions. The instance bundles no local storage and no hardware GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps. Benchmark results demonstrate consistent middle-tier performance, including a Geekbench multi-core score of 5909.0, PassMark CPU score of 11379.24, and Redis throughput of 8.0 million operations per second. However, machine learning inference on 7B models is constrained by CPU execution and memory limits. The configuration delivers predictable processing power for workloads such as Clang compilation, CI/CD pipelines, containerized microservices, and front-end web serving requiring external block storage volumes.
